Forecast Summary:
Moderate to Very Heavy rainfall (totaling around 304 mm) and generally cloudy to cloudy skies are
expected over the next few days. Temperatures will range from a maximum of 31-35°C to a minimum
of 24-26°C. The maximum relative humidity reaching 75-85% and a minimum of 70-85%.
Additionally, south-westerly surface winds blowing at average speeds will be around 6–15 kmph.
Weather Warnings (Valid Till 08:30 IST of the next day)
Yellow Alert for Heavy Rain, Thunderstorms & Lightning, Squall etc. has been issued between
September 14 to 16, 2026.
Likely impacts of weather warnings on Agriculture and associated Agromet advisories
Likely Impacts on Agriculture Crop Lodging: Squalls and gusty winds can cause the lodging (bending
or uprooting) of tall standing crops such as sugarcane, cotton, and fruit crops like banana. Chemical
Wash-off: The moderate to heavy rainfall associated with the thunderstorm wash away freshly applied
fertilizers and pesticide sprays. Livestock & Human Safety: Lightning strikes pose a direct and fatal
threat to farm laborers working in open fields and livestock grazing outdoors. Associated Agromet
Advisories Postpone Field Operations: Strictly postpone all scheduled spraying of pesticides,
herbicides, and fertilizer top-dressing to prevent them from washing away in the rain. Crop Support:
Provide immediate physical support (propping, staking, or tying) to tall and heavily fruiting crops like
sugarcane and banana to protect them from squall winds. Safety Measures: Farmers and farm laborers
must immediately stop fieldwork and seek safe, indoor shelter during thunderstorm and lig

General Advisory:
•Irrigation: With heavy rainfall forecasted over the next 5 days, strictly withhold all irrigation to Kharif
crops. •Drainage Management: Immediate priority must be given to field drainage. Deepen and clear all
drainage channels (trenches/furrows) to prevent severe waterlogging, which will rapidly cause root
anoxia and wilt in standing crops. •Spraying & Fertilizers: Strictly suspend all scheduled pesticide,
herbicide, and foliar fertilizer sprays. Applying them now will result in 100% wash-off and economic
loss. Wait for clear weather. •Pest/Disease Watch: Continuous dense cloud cover and 95% relative
humidity create a highly favorable environment for soil-borne fungal diseases (wilt, root rot) and blight.
Monitor crops closely once the rains subside. •Weed/Intercultural Operations: Postpone all manual
weeding, hoeing, and intercultural operations. Entering waterlogged fields will severely damage soil
structure. Wait until the soil returns to 'Vapsa' (workable moisture) condition.
SMS Advisory:
Heavy rain & thunderstorms are expected. Do NOT irrigate Kharif crops. Stop spraying and ensure
clear drainage.

Horticulture Specific Advisory:
Horticulture (Stage) Horticulture Specific Advisory
•Young Plant Support: Stake young plants firmly to protect them from
upcoming heavy rain and strong winds. •Stem Borer Control: Kill stem grubs
and plug their holes with mud and Chlorpyriphos 20 EC (25 ml/10 L of
water) before rains begin. •Disease Prevention: Apply 10% Bordeaux paste
MANGO to pruned or cut branches during clear weather to stop fungal infections. •
New Plantations: Prepare pits using healthy saplings, 10 kg FYM, 1 kg SSP, 1
kg MOP, and 50 ml Chlorpyriphos per tree for termite management. •
Fertilizers Postponed: Strictly suspend all chemical (Urea, SSP, MOP) and
biofertilizers to prevent severe nutrient leaching during the rain spell.
•Weed Management & Interculturing: Perform interculturing and manual
weeding in the planted field strictly when the soil reaches the 'Vapsa'
(workable moisture) condition to keep the field weed-free and aerate the
BANANA
roots. •Irrigation Management: Since mostly dry weather is forecasted,
monitor the soil moisture closely and apply light irrigation to the newly
planted crop as needed.
Live Stock Specific Advisory:
Live Stock Live Stock Specific Advisory
•Housing & Hygiene: Keep animals in clean, dry sheds. Regularly sprinkle
dry slaked lime (Chuna) on the floor to maintain hygiene and prevent diseases
like Foot Rot and Mastitis. •Fodder & Nutrition: Strictly avoid feeding old
damp or fungus-infested fodder from past rains. Ensure a daily dose of
COW mineral mixture and clean drinking water. •Healthcare: Administer
deworming medicines as advised by a veterinarian and complete any pending
vaccinations (FMD, HS, and BQ). •Pest Control: Clear any old stagnant
water around the shed. Burn dry neem leaves in the evening to control
mosquitoes, flies, and ticks.
Poultry Specific Advisory:
Poultry Poultry Specific Advisory
•Shed Care: Ensure ventilation; hang curtains against high winds but keep
them partially open during the day. •Litter: Stir bedding regularly to prevent
ammonia, adding slaked lime powder only on damp spots. •Feed: Store feed
CHICKEN
bags on elevated wooden pallets to prevent toxic fungal growth. •Health:
Provide chlorinated or sanitized water, maintain vaccinations, and consult a
vet if birds seem sick.
